description: This file defines an abstract class 'ComputedRawPage' implementing the 'Page' interface, which provides methods to access raw content and filename details based on a ComputedRaw object.

classes.name: ComputedRawPage
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for pages that are based on raw computed content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page with a ComputedRaw object.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the URI of the raw content, acting as the filename.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content from the raw object.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the pure content, identical to getContent in this implementation.
